name: Saudi Arabia (1934–1938)
description: A green field with the shahada in white Arabic calligraphy above a white sword pointing towards the hoist, and a narrow white vertical stripe at the fly.
history: Version of the Saudi flag used in the 1930s, after the proclamation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932: the green flag with the shahada and sword of the Emirate of Nejd, with a narrow white stripe at the fly. By 1938 the white stripe had been dropped and the flag assumed essentially its present form, which was standardised only on 15 March 1973.

features.role: narrow white stripe at the fly
